readings.moment: The temple bell struck nine at dinner.
When the temple bell struck nine, Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine.
Félix heard a thump on the floor above him in the atelier.
After the thump, the repeater (Uncle Aurèle's) sounded ten slow deep notes.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door.
Someone came quickly down the stairs.
Bastien Girard came into the library.
The temple struck eleven, when Félix and Bastien stopped sitting together in the library.

durations: ten years (the watch has run badly for ten years)
ten years (the uncle has been offering to regulate the watch for ten years)
six minutes (between someone going up the stairs at 10:15 and coming back down at 10:21, by Félix's watch)
about twenty-eight minutes (from Bastien Girard's arrival at 10:32 by Félix's watch until the temple struck eleven, during which they sat together in the library)
whereabouts: Félix was at the dinner, where his uncle made a scene about the watch in front of everyone.
Félix's uncle and Bastien Girard quarrelled about the price of the repeater at dinner.
Félix went up to the library after dinner and stayed there alone.
Félix had brandy in the library.
Félix was in the library with his glass when the thump, the repeater, and the stairs sounds occurred.
The library is directly under the atelier.
Félix believed his uncle was working late in the atelier, as he always did.
Someone went quickly up the stairs past the library door at 10:15 (Félix did not see who).
Someone came quickly down at 10:21 (Félix did not see who).
The library door was shut, and Félix did not open it.
Bastien Girard came into the library at 10:32.
Félix and Bastien Girard sat together in the library until the temple struck eleven.
Uncle Aurèle was found at a bench directly above the library, in the atelier.
